assertions.name: full_tower_overshoots_A_ge_5
assertions.source: na-Stokes super-exp period summed to n=A overshoots B_strong by >900% at ⁶Li for every bounded/amplifying body-order weight; structural (super-exp vs extensive). Few-body truncation required.

description: EXPLORATORY: refutes (scope-a) the full-tower jet-filtration binding B=Σ_{n=2}^A m_e a_D^(n) w_n summed to the nucleon count A. Multi-anchor (D..12C, Coulomb-corrected B_strong), single global scale. Every amplifying/quadratic w_n (n², [n]_q²) overshoots for A≥5 (⁶Li~+920%..¹²C~+2e6%). Structural: a_D super-exp vs B/A→const. Redirects to few-body truncation. No fit beyond one scale.
